lead.titleZh: 神经康复方向三项研究并列最高分，关注帕金森病与卒中
lead.titleEn: Neurorehab Focus: Top 3 Studies on Parkinson's and Stroke
lead.paragraphZh: 今日共有 13 条信息，其中 5 个专科领域内容值得关注。最高分条目（curatedScore 85）集中在神经康复领域，包括帕金森病中的生物反馈（系统综述）、帕金森病患者白质弥散（观察研究），以及卒中后肢体沉重感的神经知觉机制（综述）。
lead.paragraphEn: Today's digest features 13 items across 5 specialties. The highest-scoring entries (curatedScore 85) are concentrated in neurorehabilitation, covering biofeedback in Parkinson's disease (Systematic Review), white matter diffusion in Parkinson's patients (Observational Study), and the neuro-perceptual mechanisms of limb heaviness post-stroke (Scoping Review).

items.title: Characteristics of Outpatient Care Settings Associated with Implementation Outcomes for a Group Physical Therapy Program.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of a cluster randomized trial assessed associations between organizational and contextual characteristics and implementation of group physical therapy for knee osteoarthritis in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments.
items.curatedReason: 这项二次分析提示，在VHA的19个门诊PT部门推广膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗时，组织和情境因素比你想象的更关键。成功推行一个项目，不仅关乎疗效，更在于能否有效处理好管理和环境因素。
items.titleZh: 门诊护理环境中与小组物理治疗项目实施结果相关的特征。
items.summaryZh: 一项对19个退伍军人事务部（VHA）门诊物理治疗部门的二次分析研究发现，组织和情境特征与膝骨关节炎小组物理治疗项目的实施结果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis suggests that organizational and contextual factors are more critical than you might think for implementing group physical therapy for knee OA in 19 VHA outpatient PT departments. Successful program rollout isn't just about efficacy; it's about effectively managing administrative and environmental elements.
items.limitation: 本研究为二次分析，受限于原始集群随机试验的设计和数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is a secondary analysis, limited by the design and data of the original cluster randomized trial.

items.title: Biofeedback in Parkinson's disease: A systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis of randomized trials found that adding biofeedback to practice effectively improves lower limb activity in people with Parkinson's disease compared to practice alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述明确指出，生物反馈对改善帕金森病患者的下肢活动能力是有效的。你应该考虑在常规训练中加入生物反馈，以期提升患者的平衡和步态表现。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病中的生物反馈：一项系统综述与Meta分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对帕金森病患者的随机试验系统综述与Meta分析显示，在训练中加入生物反馈能有效改善下肢活动能力，优于单独训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review clearly indicates that biofeedback effectively improves lower limb activity in people with Parkinson's disease. You should consider incorporating biofeedback into routine practice to enhance your patients' balance and gait performance.
items.limitation: 具体生物反馈类型、训练强度和持续时间的异质性可能影响结果的解读和临床应用。
items.limitationEn: Heterogeneity in specific biofeedback types, training intensity, and duration may affect the interpretation and clinical application of results.

items.title: Carrying an unseen weight: the neuro-perceptual landscape of limb heaviness after stroke- a scoping review.
items.summary: This scoping review maps the evidence on perceived limb heaviness after stroke, identifying it as an under-recognized symptom associated with altered sensorimotor integration, impaired proprioception, and disrupted body representation, which current assessments often miss.
items.curatedReason: 本综述首次系统地描绘了卒中后“肢体沉重感”这一常被忽视但影响深远的主观症状的神经知觉机制。它提示你，在评估和干预卒中患者时，除了传统运动/感觉缺损，还需关注这种基于本体感觉和躯体表征异常的感知障碍，这会影响患者的依从性和康复效果。
items.titleZh: 卒中后肢体沉重感的神经知觉机制：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 这项范围综述系统地梳理了卒中后肢体沉重感的现有证据，指出其是因感觉运动整合异常、本体感觉受损和躯体表征紊乱引起的未被充分认识的症状，且常规评估常无法检测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review systematically maps the neuro-perceptual landscape of perceived limb heaviness after stroke, an often-overlooked but impactful subjective symptom. It suggests that, beyond traditional motor/sensory deficits, clinicians must also consider this perceptual disturbance rooted in altered proprioception and body representation when assessing and intervening with stroke patients, as it can affect adherence and rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未能提供量化的效应大小和干预建议，仅基于现有文献的叙述性综合。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review provides a narrative synthesis of existing literature and does not offer quantified effect sizes or specific intervention recommendations.

items.title: White Matter Diffusion Anisotropy and the Effects of Inpatient Multidisciplinary Rehabilitation in Parkinson's Disease: A Diffusion Tensor Imaging Analysis.
items.summary: This study investigated whether pretreatment corticospinal tract (CST) fractional anisotropy (FA) predicts inpatient rehabilitation response in 94 Parkinson's disease patients. Patients were classified as responders (UPDRS Part III improvement ≥2.5 points; n=61) or non-responders (n=33).
items.curatedReason: 对于帕金森病患者，治疗前的皮质脊髓束（CST）分数各向异性（FA）可能预示住院康复效果。这项观察研究提示，FA值或许能帮助我们区分康复的“响应者”（61人）与“无响应者”（33人），从而更精准地制定个体化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者白质弥散各向异性与住院多学科康复效果的关系：一项弥散张量成像分析
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了帕金森病患者入院前皮质脊髓束 (CST) 分数各向异性 (FA) 是否能预测住院康复效果。研究纳入 94 例患者，根据 UPDRS Part III 评分改善情况分为康复应答者 (n=61) 和非应答者 (n=33)。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pretreatment corticospinal tract (CST) fractional anisotropy (FA) may predict inpatient rehabilitation response in Parkinson's disease patients. This observational study suggests FA values could help differentiate rehabilitation 'responders' (n=61) from 'non-responders' (n=33), potentially leading to more precise, individualized rehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小（94 例 PD 患者），且仅限于住院多学科康复项目。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a relatively small sample size (94 PD patients) and was limited to an inpatient multidisciplinary rehabilitation program.

items.title: Extended-Window Thrombolysis Improves Stroke Outcomes with increased bleeding risk: JAMA
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 14 RCTs (N=4,174) found that intravenous thrombolysis given ≥4.5 hours after acute ischemic stroke onset improved functional outcomes (NNT 12–16) but increased symptomatic intracerebral hemorrhage (RR 2.44, NNH 62).
items.curatedReason: 这项涵盖4,174名患者的系统综述证实，急性缺血性卒中溶栓窗口延长至4.5小时后仍能改善功能，NNT为12-16。尽管颅内出血风险（NNH 62）增加，但对部分患者来说，这仍值得你密切关注其溶栓后的康复进展。
items.titleZh: 延长时间窗溶栓改善卒中结局，但出血风险增加：JAMA。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含14项随机试验（4,174名患者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，急性缺血性卒中发作4.5小时后进行的静脉溶栓能改善功能预后（NNT 12–16），但会增加症状性颅内出血风险（RR 2.44，NNH 62）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review of 4,174 patients confirms that intravenous thrombolysis for acute ischemic stroke, even ≥4.5 hours post-onset, improves functional outcomes (NNT 12–16). Despite increased intracerebral hemorrhage risk (NNH 62), you should closely monitor post-thrombolysis rehabilitation for select patients.
items.limitation: 研究指出，延长时间窗溶栓的出血风险增加，提示临床决策需平衡获益与风险。
items.limitationEn: The study notes an increased bleeding risk with extended-window thrombolysis, indicating that clinical decisions require balancing benefits and risks.

items.title: Application of non-invasive electroencephalogram-based brain-computer interfaces in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation.
items.summary: This article reviews the application of non-invasive EEG-based brain-computer interfaces (BCI) in post-stroke hand function rehabilitation, explaining how BCI decodes imagined hand movements to drive exoskeletons, FES, or VR, thereby strengthening neural pathways and promoting motor recovery.
items.curatedReason: 脑机接口（BCI）是卒中后手功能康复的新兴方向，对于传统康复难以奏效的无主动运动能力患者尤为关键。它为你展示了基于 EEG 的 BCI 如何通过意念驱动外部设备，有望重塑受损神经通路，为难治性卒中手功能障碍提供突破口。
items.titleZh: 非侵入性 EEG 脑机接口在卒中后手功能康复中的应用
items.summaryZh: 本文综述了非侵入性 EEG 脑机接口（BCI）在卒中后手功能康复中的应用，阐述了 BCI 如何通过解码意念运动驱动外骨骼、FES 或 VR 设备，以强化神经通路并促进运动恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Brain-computer interfaces (BCI) represent an emerging direction for post-stroke hand function rehabilitation, especially crucial for patients lacking active movement who don't benefit from conventional therapy. This article illustrates how EEG-based BCI, by driving external devices with imagined movements, holds promise for reshaping damaged neural pathways, offering a breakthrough for refractory stroke-related hand dysfunction.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述，主要关注技术原理和应用前景，缺乏具体的临床试验数据和效果量化。
items.limitationEn: This is a review primarily focusing on technical principles and potential applications, lacking specific clinical trial data and quantified outcomes.

items.title: [Viewpoint] Risk of transmission of amyloid β pathology via transfused blood products
items.summary: This viewpoint discusses concerns about the potential transmission of amyloid β pathology, relevant to Alzheimer's disease, via transfused blood products, drawing parallels with iatrogenic Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease and past medical procedures.
items.curatedReason: 这篇观点文章探讨了阿尔茨海默病中淀粉样蛋白 β 病理通过输血传播的潜在风险。虽然属于神经科范畴，但它提出了对既往医源性传播（如生长激素治疗）的关注，以及未来对血制品筛选的潜在影响，为你关注的神经退行性疾病风险管理提供了新视角。
items.titleZh: 观点：输血制品传播淀粉样蛋白 β 病理的风险
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章讨论了通过输血制品传播与阿尔茨海默病相关的淀粉样蛋白 β 病理的潜在风险，并将其与医源性克雅氏病及过往医疗操作进行了比较。
items.curatedReasonEn: This viewpoint discusses the potential risk of amyloid β pathology transmission via transfused blood products in Alzheimer's disease. While neurological, it highlights concerns regarding past iatrogenic transmissions (e.g., growth hormone therapy) and potential future implications for blood product screening, offering a new perspective on neurodegenerative disease risk management.

items.title: Method comparison of a ring-based PPG device and a chest-strap monitor for heart rate and heart rate variability in shooting athletes
items.summary: This study examined the device-to-device agreement between a ring-based photoplethysmography (PPG) device and a chest-strap monitor for heart rate and heart rate variability in shooting athletes.
items.curatedReason: 这项对射击运动员的研究表明，环式PPG设备在心率和心率变异性测量上与胸带监护仪存在一定差异。如果你在监测高精度运动表现，请谨慎评估环式设备的精确度，它可能无法完全替代金标准胸带。
items.titleZh: 环式PPG设备与胸带监护仪在射击运动员心率和心率变异性测量上的方法学比较。
items.summaryZh: 本研究评估了环式光电容积描记（PPG）设备与胸带监护仪在射击运动员心率和心率变异性测量上的一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study in shooting athletes shows some discrepancies between ring-based PPG devices and chest-strap monitors for heart rate and heart rate variability. If you're monitoring high-precision athletic performance, carefully assess the accuracy of ring-based devices; they may not fully replace the gold-standard chest strap.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于射击运动员这一特定人群和特定的运动环境，其结果可能无法直接外推至其他运动或更剧烈的活动类型。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited to shooting athletes and a specific sport setting; its results may not be directly generalizable to other sports or more intense activities.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults, finding a significant relationship.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究发现社区老年人的内在能力与生活质量之间存在关联。它提示你在评估和干预老年患者时，应更全面地考虑其内在能力（如认知、营养、活动能力等），以提升其整体生活质量。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人内在能力与生活质量的关联：一项横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，在社区居住的老年人中，内在能力与生活质量之间存在显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study found an association between intrinsic capacity and quality of life in community-dwelling older adults. It suggests that when assessing and intervening with older patients, you should consider their intrinsic capacity (e.g., cognition, nutrition, mobility) more holistically to improve their overall quality of life.
items.limitation: 作为横断面研究，本研究只能揭示内在能力与生活质量的关联性，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, this research can only reveal associations between intrinsic capacity and quality of life, not establish causality.

items.title: Strengthening Cardiac Rehabilitation: Key Strategies for Enhancing Accessibility and Outcomes
items.summary: This study identified key strategies for strengthening cardiac rehabilitation programs from interviews with 10 leaders of high-performing sites, revealing common themes like patient-centered education, personalized exercise plans, and proactive support to overcome barriers, which are associated with improved participation and adherence.
items.curatedReason: 这份初步研究揭示了表现优异的心脏康复项目在提高参与度和依从性方面的共性策略，例如患者教育、个性化方案和克服障碍支持。你可以从中借鉴这些实践经验，思考如何在自己的项目中优化患者管理和支持，以提升康复依从性。
items.titleZh: 强化心脏康复：提升可及性和疗效的关键策略
items.summaryZh: 本研究通过对 10 位高绩效心脏康复项目领导者的访谈，识别了强化心脏康复的关键策略，揭示了以患者为中心的教育、个性化运动方案和积极支持克服障碍等共同主题，这些策略与更高的参与度和依从性相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary study identifies common strategies used by high-performing cardiac rehabilitation programs to boost participation and adherence, such as patient education, personalized plans, and support for overcoming barriers. You can draw upon these practical insights to optimize patient management and support within your own programs, thereby improving rehabilitation adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（10 名 CR 领导者），为定性访谈形式，其结果的普遍适用性有待进一步大规模验证。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (10 CR leaders) and is based on qualitative interviews, so the generalizability of its findings requires further large-scale validation.

items.title: [Articles] Liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab versus maintenance therapy for locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (TALENTOP): a multicentre, open-label, randomised, phase 3 trial
items.summary: A multicenter, open-label, randomized, phase 3 trial (TALENTOP) found that liver resection after atezolizumab and bevacizumab prolonged time to treatment failure compared to maintenance therapy for patients with locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with macrovascular invasion.
items.curatedReason: 这项三期临床试验提示，对于伴有大血管侵犯的局部晚期肝细胞癌患者，在全身治疗后进行肝切除术可能比单纯维持治疗更能延长治疗失败时间。这为物理治疗师提供了背景信息，了解此类患者的治疗路径及其预后考量。
items.titleZh: TALENTOP：阿替利珠单抗联合贝伐珠单抗后肝切除术与维持治疗用于局部晚期肝细胞癌的3期随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心、开放标签、随机、3期临床试验（TALENTOP）发现，对于伴有大血管侵犯的局部晚期肝细胞癌患者，阿替利珠单抗联合贝伐珠单抗后进行肝切除术，相比单纯维持治疗，能延长治疗失败时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This phase 3 trial suggests that liver resection after systemic therapy, compared to maintenance therapy alone, may prolong time to treatment failure for patients with locally advanced hepatocellular carcinoma with macrovascular invasion. This provides physical therapists with background on the treatment pathways for these patients and their prognostic considerations.
items.limitation: 本研究为开放标签设计，可能存在一定偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This study used an open-label design, which may introduce some bias.

flashes.title: Person-centred working relationships that focus on the unique goals of the individual are the heart of supported self-management: a qualitative study with stroke survivors.

flashes.title: Towards global standards in stroke rehabilitation and recovery: An international evaluation of practice alignment.
